Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Research Associate post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate post at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is M.Tech Biotechnology with three years of industrial experience, or four years of experience if pursuing PhD studies (not yet awarded).

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job opening?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the location of the IIT Roorkee campus?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.
